comments.author: Port Official
comments.body: If you do so, you will gain some notority and lose fame (not only battle fame, but the 3 types of fame), but you won't get enough notority to become pirate with just 1 npc kill. If i do remember I think you get around 200-300 notority per fleet you take down, and you need 1k noto to become pirate
